title: MZ Help getting to appear at safe place after Game Over

posts.author: Gatamandra
posts.body:
Hi! I´m using McKathlin_GameOver
https://www.tyruswoo.com/rpg-maker/mz/game-over-mz/
so after a game over in a battle the player could re appear at the last safe place (a bar) in each different map you visit, like you do in Pokemon with pokemon centers. So I thought I could set a variable for the map, player to appear on the bar position and make the transfer there, however when I run the plugin with this set up, I appear on the top of the map, the text keeps repeating alongside the fade in and I can´t move the character, if I set this up wrong (which I most likely did) how could I fixed it?
I put the event controlling the variables right in front of the bar but I don´t know if that´s how it works, I don´t see any input to put the numbers of the coordinates or the specific Map ID
thanks a mil!

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
Please don't crop your screen shots. The second screen shot has information cropped out.
2 things worth checking.
1) although I'm not familiar with this plugin, it appears party death and "after game over" common events are set to the same common event, which may be the cause of the repeating text, since I think it will call the event twice.
2) the bar event getting player location should not be a parallel event without an end, so add an "erase event" command. There is no reason to constantly update that information as you are currently doing now.

I did what you told me and remove the party death option of the plugin and put also the end to the parallel process, and now it let´s you get control of the character again, though the even now repeats itself twice before letting yourself keep going (before it was infinitely so it´s an improvement!)
